caseNameFull: Jim Denson v. State of Georgia
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Georgia.
attorneys: Mr. John Randolph Cooper for plaintiff in error. Mr. George M. Napier, with whom Mr. Seward M. Smith was on the brief, for defendant in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction. § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, § 2, 39 Stat. 726; Jett Bros. Distilling Co. v. Carrollton, 252 U. S. 1, 5-6.
